reason: The first thing I think is whether my bank details are safe if an app reads my slips. The page says only the transaction details are saved and the PDF is read in my browser, which helps, but it does not say where the data lives or who can see it. I also quit the last budget app within weeks, so I would not pay on day 14 for something I have not seen stay useful.
objection: Whether my bank slips and card statement data are safe, and who on their side can access them.
would_change_my_mind: A plain explanation of where my transaction data is stored, who can access it, and how to delete it, plus a trial where I see my own K PLUS slip come through and stay useful for a few weeks.
